description: This file defines the TaxConfiguration class, which encapsulates various tax settings for an e-commerce application, including methods for JSON serialization and getter/setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: TaxConfiguration
classes.description: Represents tax configuration settings saved in MerchantConfiguration, capable of serializing to JSON and providing accessors for tax-related options.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the object into a JSON string, including the tax basis calculation.

methods.name: setTaxBasisCalculation
methods.description: Sets the tax basis calculation method.

methods.name: getTaxBasisCalculation
methods.description: Retrieves the current tax basis calculation method.

methods.name: setCollectTaxIfDifferentProvinceOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Sets whether to collect tax if the customer's province differs from the store's country.

methods.name: isCollectTaxIfDifferentProvinceOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Checks if tax collection applies when the customer's province differs from the store's country.

methods.name: setCollectTaxIfDifferentCountryOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Sets whether to collect tax if the customer's country differs from the store's country.

methods.name: isCollectTaxIfDifferentCountryOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Checks if tax collection applies when the customer's country differs from the store's country.
